title: Container With Most Water
description: Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container holding the most water.

data.text: Given an integer array `height` where `height[i]` is the height of a vertical line at position `i`, find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container that holds the most water. Return the maximum amount of water.
Try every pair of lines. O(n²) time.

data.title: Brute Force O(n²)

data.text: Start with the widest container. Always move the shorter side inward — a taller side cannot help if the width shrinks. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Two Pointers O(n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n²) → O(n). **Space:** O(1). Moving the shorter pointer is safe because any container using the shorter side cannot beat the current one if we shrink width.
